┌─ Help: Moving, doors, people ────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Moving and doors                                                             │
│   Arrows, W A S D   tap for one 3 m step; hold to walk that way, let go to   │
│                     stop                                                     │
│   Esc               stop a walk begun by an Option-click                     │
│   E, Enter          go through the nearest door (stand at it)                │
│   M                 the large map: Option-click a spot to walk there         │
│                                                                              │
│   A terminal that reports key releases (Kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm, recent      │
│   iTerm2) stops you the moment you let go. Any other steps once on a single  │
│   press and walks while the key repeats, stopping about a tenth of a second  │
│   after the repeats stop. Two keys held at once walk a diagonal where your   │
│   terminal reports them.                                                     │
│   Your own mark runs ahead of the server's word so a key shows at once, and  │
│   it never walks through a wall; the server settles where you are. The       │
│   status line says how fast you go on the ground you stand on.               │
│   A door (D) leads to the next zone or to an instance. A zone line (the east │
│   gate, say) takes you across; E at the far side brings you back. A door     │
│   that cannot be used says why in the line under the log, and Nearby marks   │
│   it (shut).                                                                 │
│ Page 1 of 10  Up, Down scroll  ? next page  Left, Right turn  Esc closes     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
